language_unreviewed: No native speaker has checked this translation yet.
login_intro: Paste the token that “ottie token” prints.
login_unreachable: Can’t reach Ottie. Is “ottie serve” running?
login_hint: Or run “ottie open” to open this page signed in.
add_automatic_hint: Chosen by file type. The file's real name on the server can still change it.
add_folder_hint: Chosen by the folder: a category's folder puts it in that category, any other folder in {other}.
add_streaming_hint: Comes in order, the end of the file first, so it can play while downloading.
add_exists_hint: Rename keeps both. Replace puts the new file in its place once the download is complete.
empty: Nothing yet. Paste a link above to tuck a file away.
remove_confirm: Remove “{name}” and delete what’s downloaded so far?
cancel_confirm: Cancel “{name}” and delete what’s downloaded so far?
status_waiting_retry: Waiting for a free slot to retry
det_no_bandwidth: None for now: the speed limit goes to other downloads (urgent ones first)
problem_http_429: The server says: too many requests (429)
problem_stalled: No data from the server for {time}
problem_remote_changing: The file kept changing on the server
problem_ftp_421: The server is busy, or allows fewer connections (421)
problem_ftp_530: The server refused the user name or password (530)
problem_ftp_550: Not on the server, or not allowed there (550)
problem_certificate: The certificate of {host} isn’t trusted. Its fingerprint (SHA-256): {fingerprint}
problem_no_tls: The server doesn’t offer encryption (TLS), which an ftpes:// link requires
reason_unsupported_scheme: Only http, https, ftp, ftps and ftpes links are supported (not {scheme}).
reason_relative_folder: The folder must be a full path.
reason_non_utf8_path: That folder name can’t be used.
reason_no_folder: Choose a folder: the category {category} has none.
reason_invalid_transition: That’s not possible in the download’s current state.
cancel_confirm_many: Cancel {count} downloads and delete what’s downloaded so far?
remove_confirm_many: Remove {count} downloads and delete what’s downloaded of the unfinished ones?
dash_speed_over: Total download speed over the last {time}: {now} now, {peak} at most.
dash_span_label: How far back the graph looks
move_label: Move the selected downloads to another category
cat_intro: A download goes to the category that lists its file’s extension, and is saved in that category’s folder. Anything else goes to General.
cat_no_folder: No folder: each download must name one
cat_no_extensions: No extensions: only downloads you put here
cat_remove_confirm: Remove the category “{name}”? Its downloads move to General; their files stay where they are.
cat_extensions_hint: Separated by commas or spaces, e.g. mp4, mkv, webm
cat_speed_hint: Empty: no limit of its own
cat_running_hint: Empty: no cap of its own
reason_cannot_remove_built_in: {category} can’t be removed: Ottie needs it.
cat_other_folder: Downloads saved in a folder that belongs to no category
setup_intro: Ottie sorts downloads into categories by file type, each with its own folder. Keep the ones you want; you can change them later on the Categories page.
setup_folder_hint: Files that fit no category go here, in General.
setup_welcome: A few choices to start with. Skip any of them: they’re all in Settings too.
setup_downloads_intro: Where files go, how many download at once, and what happens when a file is already there.
setup_categories_made: The starter categories are made. Change them on the Categories page.
set_appearance_hint: The look and the language are kept on this device only.
set_palette_sea_hint: Seafoam by day, Lagoon by night
set_palette_neutral_hint: Pearl by day, Slate by night
set_language_hint: Also for what the daemon reports, such as why a download failed.
set_motion_hint: Dialogs, menus and lists move into place. Chosen for this device only.
set_motion_system_less: None for now: the system asks for less motion. Chosen for this device only.
queue_drag: Drag to move {name} in the queue (or use the arrow keys)
cat_try_placeholder: Paste a link to see its category
cat_general_extensions: Every extension no other category lists
set_sync_hint: The look and the language are the same on every device where this is on.
set_max_concurrent_hint: The others wait in the queue. Lowering it never stops a running download.
set_stream_media: Streaming mode for videos and music
set_stream_media_hint: New video and music downloads come in order, the end of the file first, so they can play while downloading. Each download can still change it.
limit_total_hint: Shared between running downloads by priority. Also in the title bar.
limit_chip_hint: Shared between running downloads by priority.
set_retries_hint: When a connection drops or a server is busy, Ottie tries again by itself.
set_max_retries_hint: In a row, counted since data last arrived. 0 never retries.
set_first_wait_hint: Each next wait is twice as long, up to a minute. A server can ask for longer.
set_yield_hint: A retrying download keeps its slot this many times, then lets a waiting one go first.
read_only_note: Read-only: this device can see and play downloads, not change them.
storage_failing: Ottie can’t save its list of downloads: changes may be lost when it stops. Free some disk space or check the drive.
reason_read_only: This device is read-only: it can’t change anything.
reason_owner_only: Only the computer running Ottie can do this.
reason_folder_not_allowed: This device can’t save downloads in {folder}: only in a category’s folder or one listed in Settings.
reason_invalid_device_name: A device’s name needs 1 to 60 characters.
reason_device_not_found: That device isn’t there any more.
set_devices_hint: Each phone, computer or TV gets a sign-in link of its own. Removing one signs it out at once and leaves the others signed in.
set_device_link_hint: Shown only this once. Open it on the device; from elsewhere, use the address the device reaches this computer at (your network, a VPN).
set_device_remove_confirm: Sign out {name}? Its link stops working at once.
set_owner_only_hint: Devices and folders are managed on the computer running Ottie.
set_folders_hint: Besides each category’s folder. This computer may use any folder.
set_folders_label: A folder, as a full path
set_playing_hint: What Play opens on this computer
set_play_system_hint: Whatever opens playlists (.m3u) here. To make it VLC, set VLC as the default app for .m3u files in your system’s settings.
set_play_browser_hint: In a new tab. Browsers can’t play every file, MKV especially
set_play_program_none: Choose a player, such as VLC or mpv
set_app_hint: How the app behaves on this computer
set_close_to_tray: Keep running in the tray when closed
set_close_to_tray_hint: Closing the window hides it, and downloads go on. To quit, use the menu of Ottie’s icon in the tray.
set_startup: When you sign in to this computer
set_startup_tray_hint: Unfinished downloads carry on, with the tray icon and notifications
set_startup_daemon_hint: They carry on with nothing on screen: no tray icon or notifications until you open Ottie, and quitting Ottie then leaves them running
set_startup_off_hint: Ottie starts when you open it
set_notifications_hint: What the desktop app tells you on this computer
set_notify_all_hint: One notification when nothing is downloading or waiting any more
set_notify_each_hint: A notification as each one finishes
set_notify_never_hint: The download list still shows them
set_notify_failed_hint: After its last retry, or at once when retrying can’t help
set_sounds_hint: Each set has a sound for a finished download and another for a failed one
fl_views_hint: Saved views show up as quick filters
det_none_hint: Select a download to see its details and settings here.
det_several_hint: Select only one to see its details.
det_play_hint: Plays in your browser, even before the download is finished
det_play_hint_app: Plays in the player chosen in Settings, even before the download is finished
det_open_player_hint: Saves a small playlist (.m3u): open it, and your system’s player plays the download, even before it’s finished. To make that VLC, set it as the default app for .m3u files.
det_copy_link_hint: A link for VLC or another player, valid until it goes unused for 12 hours. Anyone who has it can play this file.
open_gone: “{name}” isn’t there any more: it was moved or deleted.
folder_gone: The folder of “{name}” isn’t there any more.
det_rename_hint: Download it under another name, beside the file already there
det_replace_hint: Download it, then put it in place of the file already there
det_trust_hint: From now on, downloads from {host} accept this certificate, and only this one. Only if it’s that server’s own (a NAS or a router that made its own). Then the download starts again.
det_limit_hint: Its own cap. The total and category limits still apply.
det_priority_hint: Higher gets more of the total limit and starts sooner. Urgent goes first.
det_streaming_hint: In order, the end of the file first, so it can play while downloading. Over one connection, it comes in order anyway.
view_save_hint: Keeps the filters and the sorting shown now.
view_delete_confirm: Delete the view “{name}”? Your downloads stay as they are.
reason_invalid_certificate: That isn’t a server name and a certificate fingerprint (SHA-256, 64 hex digits).
reason_certificate_not_found: That certificate is no longer trusted.
reason_job_moving: That download is being moved. Try again once it’s done.
reason_cannot_move_while_running: This download can’t resume, so it can only move to another folder once it’s finished.
batch_text_placeholder: Paste links, one per line, or any text that contains them: an email, a web page…
batch_text_hint: Links start with http://, https:// or ftp://. Each one is downloaded on its own. A numbered series fits in one link: [001-120], [a-z], [0-100:10], \{small,large\}.
batch_existing_of: What to do with {name}, already in the folder
batch_some_refused: Downloads added: {count}. The links left couldn’t be added; each one says why.
reason_too_many_links: That’s {count} links at once; the most is {max} (Settings, Downloads).
set_max_batch_hint: When adding several links at once. More are refused, all of them.
set_existing_hint: When nobody is asked: a link added straight from the clipboard, or a file the server names differently from its link.
set_existing_rename: Save the new one under another name
set_existing_replace: Replace it once the new one is complete
det_schedule_hint: Empty: it starts as soon as it can, and doesn’t stop on its own. A running download given a start time stops until then.
add_when_hint: Empty: it starts now, and doesn’t stop on its own.
reason_stop_before_start: The stop time must come after the start time.
slot_bad_max: How many at once: from {min} to {max}.
slot_need_limit: Turn on a speed limit or how many at once.
reason_slot_without_effect: Choose what the slot does: allow or stop downloads, or set a limit.
reason_slot_not_found: That time slot no longer exists.
reason_invalid_time: “{text}” isn’t a time or a date.
reason_invalid_slot_order: The time slots changed meanwhile; try again.
sched_intro: Time slots say when downloads run, stop or slow down, for all of them or one category. Where two apply at once, the higher one in the list wins.
sched_time_zone_local: Times are those of the computer running Ottie.
sched_week_label: The time slots over this week
sched_week_hint: Drag a slot to move it, or its top or bottom edge to change when it starts or ends. Click it to edit it.
sched_empty: No time slots yet: downloads run whenever they can.
sched_editor_overlaps: Overlaps {names}. Where two set the same thing differently, the higher one in the list wins.
sched_hours_hint: An end before the start runs into the next day; the same time twice is a whole day.
sched_leave_hint: Changes the speed or how many run at once; never starts or stops a download.
sched_allow_hint: Downloads run, even where a slot lower in the list stops them. Limits are optional.
sched_stop_hint: No download starts while it lasts.
sched_carry_on_hint: The downloads it held start again by themselves.
sched_stay_paused_hint: The downloads it held stay paused until you resume them. Switching the slot off or removing it lets them go on.
sched_limit_hint: In total for those it applies to. Empty: no limit while it lasts.
finish_sleep_hint: Low power, wakes up in seconds
finish_hibernate_hint: Saves what’s open to disk and turns off
finish_cant_hibernate: Hibernation is off on this computer
finish_cant_shut_down: Ottie isn’t allowed to shut down this computer
finish_once_hint: This time only. Settings choose for every time.
finish_failed: Couldn’t change what happens when everything has finished.
set_finish_hint: Every time downloads finish. Ottie’s menu and the Downloads page can choose otherwise for once.
set_countdown_hint: Time to cancel before the computer sleeps, hibernates or shuts down
set_countdown_window_hint: On top of everything, with Cancel
set_countdown_notification_hint: Cancel it from Ottie’s menu or the Downloads page
set_finish_waits_hint: Off: finished as soon as nothing is left to run now
caught_more_hint: Choose the category and folder in Ottie
caught_failed: Ottie can’t read these links right now.
set_clipboard_hint: Download links you copy in other apps
set_watch_clipboard_hint: Only links to the file types your categories list. Not what you copy in Ottie, nor what a password manager marks as private.
set_copied: When a download link is copied
set_copied_ask_hint: A small window in the corner of the screen offers it, without interrupting what you’re doing
set_copied_add_hint: In its category, with a notification
setup_clipboard_hint: Ottie offers the download links you copy in other apps. You can change this later in Settings → Clipboard.
shortcuts_typing: Not while typing in a field.
set_keyboard_hint: Press ? on any page to show them.
shortcut_paste: Add a copied link (several open the list)
shortcut_step: Select the previous or next download
shortcut_queue: Move up or down in the queue
shortcut_queue_ends: Move to the top or bottom of the queue
others_hint_app: Show another computer’s Ottie in this window. Add it with a sign-in link made there for this computer.
others_hint_browser: Go to another computer’s Ottie from here. This list stays in this browser, for this address.
others_not_ottie: Something answered there, but not Ottie.
others_refused: That Ottie doesn’t accept this sign-in link (any more).
others_keychain: The system’s keychain couldn’t keep or give back the token.
others_not_found: It’s no longer on the list.
others_cant_start: Ottie couldn’t start on this computer.
set_local_always_hint: Its downloads carry on while the window shows another computer’s Ottie
set_local_when_shown_hint: Starts when you switch to it, from the next start on: for a computer that only drives another one
cert_hint: FTPS servers whose own certificate you trusted from a download. Remove one, and its certificate is refused again.
ext_permission: Ottie needs access to every site: to send a download’s cookies with it, and to reach Ottie wherever it runs.
ext_unreachable: Ottie doesn’t answer at {address}. Is it running?
ext_refused: Ottie refused this browser’s token. Sign in again with a new link.
ext_signed_out: Not signed in: downloads stay in the browser.
ext_link_hint: In Ottie, Settings → Connection: add this browser as a device and copy its sign-in link. On the computer Ottie runs on, the command ottie link prints one too.
ext_take_over_hint: Downloads started in this browser go to Ottie instead, with the site’s cookies. Those Ottie can’t fetch again (from a form, or made by the page) stay in the browser, as do those of private windows.
ext_min_size: Leave small files to the browser
ext_min_size_hint: Files the site says are smaller than this stay in the browser. 0: none do.
ext_excluded_hint: Their downloads stay in the browser. One per line; each covers its subdomains.
ext_pair_here: Sign in to Ottie on this computer
ext_pair_here_hint: Where Ottie is installed, this browser signs in by itself, and Ottie starts when a download comes.
ext_no_host: Ottie isn’t set up for this browser on this computer: install the desktop app, or run the command ottie extension install. Or sign in with a link.
